blocks.text: Exercise mein das multiple choice, aath short aur aath long sawal hain (long sawal 7 kitab mein number ke baghair chhapa hai). Har sawal ka hal yahan diya gaya hai: MCQ ka sahi jawab chapter ke text ke mutabiq hai, aur jahan kitab ki answer key (Unit 4) mukhtalif hai wahan 'Kitab ki ghalti' box hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. Which function is used to add an item at the end of the list in python?
Python mein list ke aakhir mein item jorne ke liye kaunsa function hai?
blocks.explanation: append() item ko list ke aakhir mein jorta hai (4.1.1.3). insert() kisi khaas position par jorta hai, aur remove() aur pop() items nikalte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (c) deti hai. Magar remove() to item nikalta hai; chapter (4.1.1.3) ke mutabiq aakhir mein item append() jorta hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. What does the 'in' keyword do when used with python list?
Python list ke saath 'in' keyword kya karta hai?

options.text: check karta hai ke item list mein hai ya nahi

blocks.explanation: 'in' keyword check karta hai ke item list mein mojood hai ya nahi, aur True ya False deta hai, maslan if "Buy cold drinks" in party_list: (4.1.1.3, Searching).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which operation removes an item from the top of the stack?
Stack ke top se item kaunsa operation nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pop stack ke top wala item nikalta hai (4.1.2.2). Push item jorta hai aur peek sirf top item dekhta hai, nikalta nahi.

blocks.prompt:
4. When converting an infix expression to postfix notation, what does a stack help to manage?
Infix ko postfix mein badalte waqt stack kis cheez ko sambhalne mein madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Conversion (4.1.3.1) mein operands seedhe output mein jate hain, un ke liye stack nahi chahiye. Stack operators rakhta hai ta ke zyada ya barabar priority (darja) wala operator pehle pop ho, aur '(' ko us waqt tak rakhta hai jab tak ')' na aa jaye. Is liye stack priority aur brackets dono sambhalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (c) deti hai. Magar chapter ke rules (4.1.3.1) mein stack operators ki priority bhi sambhalta hai (3 + 4 * 2 mein koi bracket nahi, phir bhi * stack par + ke oopar rukta hai), is liye poora sahi jawab (d) b aur c dono hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which operation is used to add an item to a queue?
Queue mein item jorne ke liye kaunsa operation hai?
blocks.explanation: Enqueue item ko queue ke peeche (rear) jorta hai (4.1.4.2). Dequeue aage wala item nikalta hai aur peek sirf use dekhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. In the context of Breadth-First Search (BFS) in a tree, which operation of queue is used to visit nodes level by level?
Tree par BFS mein level ba level nodes dekhne ke liye queue ka kaunsa operation istemal hota hai?

options.text: stack ke aakhir mein nodes jorna
list ke aakhir se nodes nikalna

blocks.explanation: BFS (4.1.5.2) mein har dekhe gaye node ke children queue mein enqueue hote hain aur aage se nikalte hain, is liye nodes level ba level dekhe jate hain. Stack DFS mein lagta hai, BFS mein nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (b) deti hai. List ke aakhir se nikalna stack (LIFO) wala kaam hai. BFS (4.1.5.2) nodes queue mein enqueue karta hai aur aage se nikalta hai, is liye sahi jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following tree traversals visits the root node before its children?
Kaunsa tree traversal root node ko us ke children se pehle dekhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pre-order pehle root, phir left subtree, phir right subtree dekhta hai (4.1.7.1): 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7. In-order root ko beech mein aur post-order aakhir mein dekhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (d) deti hai. Chapter (4.1.7.1) mein pre-order hi woh traversal hai jo root pehle dekhta hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) hai. (Level-order chapter ke teen traversals mein shamil nahi.)

blocks.prompt:
8. Which of the following is true about the height of a tree?
Tree ki height ke baare mein kya sach hai?

options.text: root se sab se gehre node tak edges ki ginti
root se sab se gehre node tak nodes ki ginti
root node ke children ki ginti
hamesha tree ke nodes ki ginti ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Height root se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta (path) hai (4.1.6.1), aur raasta edges (nodes ko jorne wali lakeeron) mein gina jata hai. Figure 4.8 mein (1 se 2 se 4) height 2 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (c) deti hai. Root ke children ki ginti gehrai nahi batati; 4.1.6.1 ke mutabiq height root se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta hai jo edges mein gina jata hai, is liye sahi jawab (a) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. Which graph traversal explores all immediate neighbors of a vertex before moving to the next level?
Kaunsa graph traversal agle level par jane se pehle kisi vertex ke saare qareebi parosi dekhta hai?
blocks.explanation: BFS source vertex se shuru ho kar agle level se pehle us ke saare qareebi neighbours (parosi) dekhta hai (4.1.8.3). DFS pehle ek shaakh (branch) mein jitna gehra ja sake jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (c) deti hai. Depth-Limited Search depth-first tareeqa hai jis mein gehrai ki had hoti hai, aur yeh chapter mein nahi. Chapter (4.1.8.3) yahi tareef Breadth-First Search ki deta hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. For which scenario would a graph data structure be most appropriate?
Graph data structure kis situation (soorat) ke liye sab se behtar hai?

options.text: dukaan mein gahakon ki line ka model

blocks.explanation: Graph network wale data ke liye behtar hai, jaise social network jahan users vertices aur dostiyan edges hain (4.1.8, 4.2.5). To-do list ke liye list aur gahakon ki line ke liye queue munasib hai (4.2.2, 4.2.3). Kitab ne sirf teen options chhape hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 4) (a) deti hai. To-do list tarteeb wala collection hai jis ke liye chapter list batata hai (4.2.3). Graph social network jaise networks ke liye hai (4.2.5), is liye sahi jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain how the ' extend() ' function works in python lists. Provide an example.
Python list mein extend() kaise kaam karta hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
extend() doosri list (ya sequence) ke saare items usi order mein list ke aakhir mein jorta hai; asal list bari ho jati hai.
append() sirf ek item jorta hai; extend() ek call mein kai items.
Misal: party_list.extend(["Party hats", "Streamers"]) dono items aakhir mein jorta hai, 4 items wali list 6 ki ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the potential issues which could arise when two variables reference the same list in a program? Provide an example.
Jab do variables ek hi list ko reference karein to kya problems ho sakti hain? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se aage ki baat.) list_b = list_a nayi list nahi banata; dono naam ek hi list ki taraf ishara karte hain (aliasing).
Ek naam se tabdeeli (maslan append) doosre mein bhi nazar aati hai, is liye data ghalti se badal kar bugs (ghaltiyan) bana sakta hai.
Misal: list_a = [10, 20]; list_b = list_a; list_b.append(30) se list_a bhi [10, 20, 30] ho jati hai.
Hal: alag list ke liye list_a.copy() likhein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho ek ghar ke do naam hain: kisi bhi naam se kamra banao, ghar ek hi hai. list_b = list_a bhi aisa hai: list ek, naam do. Alag ghar chahiye to .copy() likho.

blocks.prompt:
3. Define a stack and explain the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle.
Stack ki definition (tareef) bataiye aur LIFO principle (usool) samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation:
Stack aisa data structure hai jis mein items sirf ek sire (top) par jore (push) aur nikale (pop) jate hain.
LIFO (Last-In, First-Out, yaani aakhir mein aaya pehle gaya): jo item sab se aakhir mein jora woh sab se pehle nikalta hai.
Misal: kitabon ke dher mein sab se oopar rakhi kitab pehle uthti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. How does the stack help in balancing parentheses in an expression? Describe the process.
Stack expression mein brackets ka balance check karne mein kaise madad deta hai? Tareeqa bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
Stack khulne wale brackets ka hisaab rakhta hai: expression baen se daen parhein, har ( push karein aur har ) par ek pop karein.
Agar ) aaye aur stack khali ho to balanced nahi.
Aakhir mein stack khali ho to balanced; koi ( bach jaye to balanced nahi.

blocks.prompt:
5. Differentiate between the Enqueue and Dequeue operations of queue.
Queue ke Enqueue aur Dequeue operations mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Enqueue queue ke peeche (rear) item jorta hai; Dequeue aage (front) wala item nikalta hai.

rows: Queue ke peeche (rear) kaam karta hai
Queue ke aage (front) kaam karta hai
Jaise line ke aakhir mein naya banda lagta hai (FIFO)
Jaise aage wale bande ki baari aati hai (FIFO)

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain how the concept of a queue is applied in a computer's job scheduling system?
Computer ke job scheduling system mein queue ka concept (idea) kaise lagta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Processor ya printer ke intezar mein kaam queue mein rakhe jate hain aur aane ke order (FIFO) se hote hain.
Naya kaam (maslan print job) peeche enqueue hota hai; device faarigh ho to aage wala kaam dequeue ho kar chalta hai.
Is tarah har kaam barabar (fair) aur tarteeb se hota hai, jaise print spooling.

blocks.prompt:
7. How can lists be utilized to implement other data structures?
Lists se doosre data structures kaise banaye ja sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
List lachakdar (flexible) aur tarteeb wala collection hai, is liye doosre data structures is se bante hain.
Stack: append() se push, pop() se top wala item nikalna.
Queue: append() se peeche jorna, pop(0) se aage se nikalna.
Tree/graph: har node apne children ya neighbours (parosiyon) ki list rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between the Depth-First Search (DFS) and Breadth-First Search (BFS).
Depth-First Search (DFS) aur Breadth-First Search (BFS) mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: DFS ek branch mein gehra ja kar wapas aata hai; BFS level ba level saare neighbours dekhta hai.

rows: Har branch (shaakh) mein jitna gehra ja sake jata hai, phir wapas (backtrack)
Aage jane se pehle vertex ke saare neighbours (level ba level) dekhta hai
Maze aur backtracking ke liye munasib
Unweighted graph mein sab se chhota raasta dhoondta hai

blocks.prompt:
1. Discuss the dynamic size property of lists in Python. How does this property make lists more flexible?
Python lists ki dynamic size wali property bataiye; yeh lists ko flexible (lachakdar) kaise banati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Dynamic size: Python ki list program chalte waqt apna size badal sakti hai. Items kisi bhi waqt jore ya nikale ja sakte hain aur list khud ko tabdeeli ke mutabiq adjust kar leti hai (4.1.1.2). Size pehle se tay nahi karna parta.
Size kaise badalta hai:
- Barhta hai: append() aakhir mein ek item, insert() kisi position par, extend() kai items jorta hai.
- Ghatta hai: remove() value se, pop() index se nikalta hai, clear() sab items mita deta hai.
- len() hamesha mojooda items ki ginti batata hai.
Yeh lists ko flexible kaise banati hai:
1. Na maloom miqdaar ka data: aisa data rakh sakte hain jis ki ginti pehle maloom na ho, jaise user ka input, to-do list ya shopping cart.
2. Memory zaya nahi hoti: list sirf apne items jitni jagah leti hai; memory Python khud sambhalta hai.
3. Aasan tabdeeli: to-do list ki tarah kaam kabhi bhi jore ya kaate ja sakte hain.
4. Mutability (badal sakna), order aur mukhtalif qism ke items ke saath mil kar, isi se stack aur queue bante hain jo barhte ghatte hain.
Misal:
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks"]
print("Start:", items, "Size:", len(items))
items.append("Plates")                      # list grows
items.insert(0, "Balloons")
items.extend(["Cold drinks", "Party hats"])
print("After adding:", items, "Size:", len(items))
items.remove("Snacks")                      # list shrinks
items.pop()
print("After removing:", items, "Size:", len(items))
Output:
Start: ['Decorations', 'Snacks'] Size: 2
After adding: ['Balloons', 'Decorations', 'Snacks', 'Plates', 'Cold drinks', 'Party hats'] Size: 6
After removing: ['Balloons', 'Decorations', 'Plates', 'Cold drinks'] Size: 4
Ek hi list 2 se 6 items tak bari hui aur phir 4 par aa gayi, koi size batane ki zaroorat nahi pari.

blocks.prompt:
2. Write a python program to manage a project's task list. Start with an initial list containing the following tasks=[design, development, testing, deployment]. Perform the following operations on the tasks list:
- Add 'review' to the end of the list.
- Insert 'planning' at the third position in the list.
- Update 'testing' to quality assurance.
- Remove 'development ' from the list by its value.
- Remove the task at index 1 from the list.
- Find the index of the task 'deployment ' and print it.
- Print the final list after all modifications.
- Count and print the number of tasks in the list.
Project ki task list ka Python program: tasks = [design, development, testing, deployment] par oopar diye gaye aath operations.
blocks.explanation:
Program (4.1.1.3 ke list operations):
tasks = ["design", "development", "testing", "deployment"]

tasks.append("review")                       # 1. add 'review' at the end
tasks.insert(2, "planning")                  # 2. insert at the third position (index 2)
i = tasks.index("testing")                   # 3. update 'testing'
tasks[i] = "quality assurance"
tasks.remove("development")                  # 4. remove by value
tasks.pop(1)                                 # 5. remove the task at index 1
print("Index of deployment:", tasks.index("deployment"))   # 6
print("Final list:", tasks)                  # 7
print("Number of tasks:", len(tasks))        # 8
Output:
Index of deployment: 2
Final list: ['design', 'quality assurance', 'deployment', 'review']
Number of tasks: 4
List kaise badalti hai:
1. append: ['design', 'development', 'testing', 'deployment', 'review']
2. index 2 (teesri jagah) par insert: ['design', 'development', 'planning', 'testing', 'deployment', 'review']
3. update: ['design', 'development', 'planning', 'quality assurance', 'deployment', 'review']
4. remove('development'): ['design', 'planning', 'quality assurance', 'deployment', 'review']
5. pop(1) 'planning' nikalta hai: ['design', 'quality assurance', 'deployment', 'review']
6. 'deployment' index 2 par hai; aakhri list mein 4 kaam hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Teesri position ka index 2 hai kyunke ginti 0 se shuru hoti hai (0, 1, 2). 'testing' ko badalne ke liye pehle index() se us ki jagah maloom ki, phir tasks[i] = "quality assurance" se nayi value rakhi. remove() value dekh kar nikalta hai, pop() index dekh kar. Sawal mein 'development ' aur 'deployment ' ke aakhir mein space chhapa hai; program mein space ke baghair likha hai, warna Python woh item dhoond nahi payega (ValueError).

blocks.prompt:
3. Discuss two real-world situations where stacks are commonly used. Explain how stack operations function in these contexts.
Do asal zindagi ki misalein jahan stack istemal hota hai, aur un mein stack ke operations kaise chalte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Stack LIFO par chalta hai: jo aakhir mein push hua woh pehle pop hota hai. Do aam asal misalein (4.1.3):
1. Text editors (Notepad, Microsoft Word) mein Undo (4.1.3.5)
- Kaam karna: har tabdeeli (typing ya text mitana) stack par push hoti hai. "Hello" type karna push hota hai.
- Undo: Undo dabane par sab se taaza kaam pop hota hai aur editor use ulat deta hai ("Hello" mit jata hai).
- Kai Undo: dobara Undo se us se pehle wala kaam pop hota hai. "Hello" ke baad "World" likha tha to pehle Undo "World" hatata hai, doosra "Hello", yaani ulte order mein.
2. Program mein function calls ka intezam (4.1.3.3)
- Function call hone par us ki details (kya karna hai aur khatam ho kar kahan wapas jana hai) stack par push hoti hain, jaise notepad par oopar call karne wale ka naam likhna.
- Agar yeh function kisi aur function ko call kare to nayi details oopar push hoti hain.
- Function khatam ho to us ki details pop hoti hain, jaise naam kaat dena, aur computer stack mein neeche wale function par wapas chala jata hai.
- Is tarah sab se aakhir mein call hone wala function sab se pehle khatam hota hai.
Aur misalein: browser ka Back button (har khola page push; Back mojooda page pop karta hai) aur plates ya kitabon ka dher.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Undo ko aise samjho: aap ne teen kaam kiye A, phir B, phir C. Stack mein C sab se oopar hai. Undo hamesha oopar wala uthata hai, is liye pehle C, phir B, phir A wapas hote hain. Function calls mein bhi: main() ne f() ko bulaya, f() ne g() ko; g() pehle khatam hoga, phir f(), phir main().

blocks.prompt:
4. Consider the following infix expression (5 + 2) * (3 - 1).
(a) Describe the step-by-step process to convert this infix expression into postfix notation using a stack.
(b) Illustrate the state of the stack and the output list after processing each token of the infix expression.
Hint: A token is a single element in an expression, such as a number, operator, or parenthesis.
(5 + 2) * (3 - 1) ko stack se postfix banayein, aur har token (expression ka ek hissa: number, operator ya bracket) ke baad stack aur output dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
(a) Tareeqa (4.1.3.1 ke rules):
1. Khali stack aur khali output list se shuru karein.
2. Infix expression baen se daen, ek token ek baar, parhein.
3. Operand (number): seedha output list mein daal dein.
4. Operator (+, -, *): agar stack ke top par zyada ya barabar priority (darja) wala operator ho to pehle use pop kar ke output mein dalein; phir naya operator push karein. (Top par '(' ho to operator use pop nahi karta.)
5. Khulne wala bracket (: stack par push karein.
6. Band karne wala bracket ): jab tak ( na mile, operators pop kar ke output mein dalein; ( ko hata dein magar output mein na dalein.
7. Aakhir mein bache hue saare operators pop kar ke output mein dalein.
(b) Har token ke baad haalat:
Token | Kaam | Stack | Output
( | push ( | ( | (khali)
5 | operand output mein | ( | 5
+ | push + (top par '(') | ( + | 5
2 | operand output mein | ( + | 5 2
) | '(' tak pop; '(' hata dein | (khali) | 5 2 +
* | push * (stack khali) | * | 5 2 +
( | push ( | * ( | 5 2 +
3 | operand output mein | * ( | 5 2 + 3
- | push - (top par '(') | * ( - | 5 2 + 3
1 | operand output mein | * ( - | 5 2 + 3 1
) | '(' tak pop; '(' hata dein | * | 5 2 + 3 1 -
end | bache operators pop | (khali) | 5 2 + 3 1 - *
Postfix expression: 5 2 + 3 1 - *
Jaanch (4.1.3.2): 5 aur 2 push, + se 7; 3 aur 1 push, - se 2; * se 7 x 2 = 14, jo (5 + 2) * (3 - 1) = 14 ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Brackets ka kaam yeh hai ke andar wala hissa pehle ho. Is liye pehle bracket ke band hote hi + output mein chala gaya (5 2 +), aur doosre ke band hote hi - (3 1 -). * dono brackets ke beech stack par intezar karta raha aur aakhir mein nikla, kyunke use dono jawabon ko zarb dena tha. Postfix mein bracket ki zaroorat nahi rehti: computer seedha baen se daen hisaab kar leta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Write a Python code to simulate a queue of print jobs. The code perform following operations:
(a) Create an empty queue.
(b) Add three print jobs to the queue.
(c) Display the print job at the front of the queue without removing it.
(d) Remove the print job from the front of the queue.
(e) Add another print job to the queue.
(f) Display the updated queue of print jobs.
Print jobs ki queue ka Python code: khali queue banana, teen jobs jorna, aage wala job nikale baghair dikhana, aage wala nikalna, ek aur jorna, aur nayi queue dikhana.
blocks.explanation:
Program (Python ka built-in queue module, jaise 4.1.4.2 mein):
from queue import Queue

print_queue = Queue()                    # (a) create an empty queue

print_queue.put("Job 1: Report.pdf")     # (b) add three print jobs (enqueue)
print_queue.put("Job 2: Notes.docx")
print_queue.put("Job 3: Photo.png")

print("Front job:", print_queue.queue[0])        # (c) peek at the front job

removed = print_queue.get()                      # (d) remove the front job (dequeue)
print("Printed and removed:", removed)

print_queue.put("Job 4: Slides.pptx")            # (e) add another job

print("Updated queue:", list(print_queue.queue)) # (f) display the queue
Output:
Front job: Job 1: Report.pdf
Printed and removed: Job 1: Report.pdf
Updated queue: ['Job 2: Notes.docx', 'Job 3: Photo.png', 'Job 4: Slides.pptx']
Wazahat-e-code:
- Queue() khali FIFO queue banata hai.
- put() job ko peeche jorta hai (enqueue); teen jobs jore gaye.
- print_queue.queue[0] aage wala job nikale baghair dekhta hai (peek).
- get() aage wala job nikal kar wapas deta hai (dequeue); yeh Job 1 hai jo sab se pehle aaya tha.
- Job 4 peeche jur gaya, is liye nayi queue Job 2, Job 3, Job 4 hai.
(Files ke naam sirf misal hain.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Printer ke saamne line socho: Job 1 sab se aage, Job 3 sab se peeche. Peek sirf dekhna hai ke agla kaun hai, line nahi badalti. get() se Job 1 chhap kar line se nikal gaya. Naya Job 4 line ke aakhir mein khara hua. Yahi FIFO hai: pehle aaya, pehle chhapa.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the different types of tree traversals (In-order, Pre-order, Post-order). Provide an example of each traversal using a given tree structure, and explain how each traversal method processes the nodes.
In-order, pre-order aur post-order traversals misal ke saath samjhaiye, aur bataiye ke har tareeqa nodes ko kis order mein dekhta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Tree traversal ka matlab hai tree ke har node ko ek muqarrar order mein sirf ek baar dekhna (4.1.7.1). Har tareeqa har subtree par dobara (recursively) lagta hai.
Misal ka tree (Figure 4.8): root 1; left child 2 aur right child 3; 2 ke children 4 (left) aur 5 (right); 3 ke children 6 (left) aur 7 (right).
1. In-order traversal (Left, Root, Right)
- Pehle left subtree, phir root node, aakhir mein right subtree.
- Order: 4 (2 ka sab se baen wala), 2, 5, phir root 1, phir 6, 3, 7.
- Output: 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7
2. Pre-order traversal (Root, Left, Right)
- Pehle root node, phir left subtree, phir right subtree.
- Order: 1 (root), 2, 4, 5, phir 3, 6, 7.
- Output: 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7
- Istemal: file system ka backup, kyunke folder us ke andar ki cheezon se pehle aata hai.
3. Post-order traversal (Left, Right, Root)
- Pehle left subtree, phir right subtree, root sab se aakhir mein.
- Order: 4, 5, 2, phir 6, 7, 3, aakhir mein root 1.
- Output: 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1
- Istemal: file system mitana, kyunke pehle andar ke folders aur files mitte hain, phir parent folder.
Yahi tree bana kar teeno traversals print karne wala program:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, left=None, right=None):
        self.value = value
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def in_order(node):
    if node:
        in_order(node.left)
        print(node.value, end=" ")
        in_order(node.right)

def pre_order(node):
    if node:
        print(node.value, end=" ")
        pre_order(node.left)
        pre_order(node.right)

def post_order(node):
    if node:
        post_order(node.left)
        post_order(node.right)
        print(node.value, end=" ")

root = Node(1, Node(2, Node(4), Node(5)), Node(3, Node(6), Node(7)))
print("In-order:", end=" "); in_order(root); print()
print("Pre-order:", end=" "); pre_order(root); print()
print("Post-order:", end=" "); post_order(root); print()
Output:
In-order: 4 2 5 1 6 3 7
Pre-order: 1 2 4 5 3 6 7
Post-order: 4 5 2 6 7 3 1

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Naam yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa: "pre" yaani pehle, "post" yaani baad mein, "in" yaani beech mein. Yeh sirf root ki jagah batate hain: pre-order mein root pehle, in-order mein beech mein, post-order mein aakhir mein. Left hamesha right se pehle aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Consider the following graph and perform the operations specified below:
[Graph as printed: A has arrows to B, C and D; B has arrows to E and F; C has an arrow to G; D has arrows to H and I.]
(a) Start from node A, write down the sequence of nodes visited during a depth-first search traversal of the graph.
(b) Start from node A, write down the sequence of nodes visited throughout a breadth-first search traversal of the graph.
Graph (A se B, C, D ki taraf teer; B se E, F; C se G; D se H, I) mein A se shuru kar ke (a) DFS aur (b) BFS ka order likhiye.
blocks.explanation:
Neighbours (parosi) baen se daen liye gaye hain, jaise kitab ki misalon mein (4.3.2, 4.3.3).
(a) Depth-first search (DFS), stack ke saath:
- A push. A pop kar ke visit, us ke children D, C, B push (B top par). Stack: [D, C, B]
- B pop, visit, F, E push. Stack: [D, C, F, E]
- E pop, visit (koi child nahi). Stack: [D, C, F]
- F pop, visit. Stack: [D, C]
- C pop, visit, G push. Stack: [D, G]
- G pop, visit. Stack: [D]
- D pop, visit, I, H push. Stack: [I, H]
- H pop, visit. Stack: [I]
- I pop, visit. Stack: [] (khali, traversal khatam)
DFS order: A, B, E, F, C, G, D, H, I
(b) Breadth-first search (BFS), queue ke saath:
- A enqueue. A dequeue kar ke visit, B, C, D enqueue. Queue: [B, C, D]
- B dequeue, visit, E, F enqueue. Queue: [C, D, E, F]
- C dequeue, visit, G enqueue. Queue: [D, E, F, G]
- D dequeue, visit, H, I enqueue. Queue: [E, F, G, H, I]
- E, F, G, H aur I baari baari dequeue (kisi ka child nahi). Queue: [] (khali, traversal khatam)
BFS order: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I
DFS har branch (A-B-E-F) poori kar ke agli par jata hai, jabke BFS level ba level chalta hai (A; phir B, C, D; phir E, F, G, H, I).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Children ko stack par ulte order (D, C, B) mein is liye push kiya ke B top par aaye aur pehle nikle; is tarah DFS bhi baen se daen chalta hai. Queue mein ulta karne ki zaroorat nahi, kyunke jo pehle jaata hai woh pehle nikalta hai. Agar koi neighbours ko kisi aur order mein le to DFS ka order badal sakta hai; imtihan mein baen se daen wala order likhna behtar hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Consider the task of organizing a desk. Describe how you can use both a stack and a queue to manage tasks such as sorting papers, putting away books, and cleaning the desk.
Mez (desk) organize karne mein, jaise kaghaz tarteeb dena, kitabein rakhna aur mez saaf karna, stack aur queue dono kaise istemal karenge?
blocks.explanation:
Structures ka mel (4.3): queue kaamon ka order tay karti hai, aur stack har kaam ke andar ki cheezein sambhalta hai.
Kaamon ke liye queue (FIFO):
- Kaam us order mein enqueue karein jis mein karne hain: kaghaz tarteeb dena, kitabein rakhna, mez saaf karna.
- Aage se ek ek kar ke dequeue karein, ta ke har kaam plan ke order mein ho aur koi reh na jaye (task scheduling ki tarah, 4.1.5.3).
Kaghazon aur kitabon ke liye stack (LIFO):
- Kaghaz mez par dher (pile) mein hain; jo aakhir mein rakha woh oopar hai, is liye pehle utha kar (pop) file hota hai.
- Kitabein bhi Figure 4.2 ki tarah dher mein hain; oopar wali kitab pehle utha kar shelf par rakhi jati hai.
- Ghalti se kuch wapas rakh diya to sab se taaza kaam pehle ulta (undo) kiya ja sakta hai.
Dono ko dikhane wala program:
from queue import Queue

tasks = Queue()                       # jobs in the order they must be done (FIFO)
tasks.put("Sort papers")
tasks.put("Put away books")
tasks.put("Clean the desk")

papers = []                           # stack of papers (LIFO)
papers.append("Old test")
papers.append("Homework")
papers.append("Notice")

books = ["Physics", "Chemistry", "Computer"]   # stack of books on the desk

while not tasks.empty():
    task = tasks.get()                # dequeue the next task
    print("Task:", task)
    if task == "Sort papers":
        while papers:
            print("  File paper:", papers.pop())   # top paper first
    elif task == "Put away books":
        while books:
            print("  Shelve book:", books.pop())   # top book first
    else:
        print("  Desk is clean")
Output:
Task: Sort papers
  File paper: Notice
  File paper: Homework
  File paper: Old test
Task: Put away books
  Shelve book: Computer
  Shelve book: Chemistry
  Shelve book: Physics
Task: Clean the desk
  Desk is clean
Queue ne kaam order mein rakhe (kaghaz, kitabein, safai), aur har stack ne apni oopar wali cheez pehle di.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asaan lafzon mein: queue "kaunsa kaam pehle" ka jawab deti hai (jo pehle list mein aaya woh pehle). Stack "dher mein se kaunsi cheez pehle" ka jawab deta hai (jo sab se oopar, yaani aakhir mein rakhi gayi). Dono mil kar mez ka kaam tarteeb se karwa dete hain.
